name: codex-1m-context-window-setup
description: >- Configures and verifies an expanded, model-aware context window for OpenAI Codex CLI and Desktop. Use to inspect local context settings, lower or set the auto-compaction threshold, expand ~258K context to 500K or 1M, or repair model_context_window/model_auto_compact_token_limit. Not for changing the selected model or other Codex settings.
author: daymade
